title: Type or namespace not found

sourceOfTruth.rule: Confirm whether the type exists in the installed packages before adding using statements or replacements.
authoritativeInputs: installed package decompile or source-in-package files

symptoms: The type or namespace name could not be found.
A moved Core type is referenced without the new namespace.
A newly required dependency type is missing from the project references or using directives.
investigation: Search the solution for the missing type.
Search/decompile installed NGO.Core packages for the type name.
Identify whether this is a namespace move, removed type, renamed type, or missing package reference.
Load a matching symbol route if the type belongs to a high-risk Core service family.
patchRules: Add a using directive only when the type exists and namespace is confirmed.
Prefer fully qualified names when ambiguity exists.
Add missing package references only when restore evidence proves the package is absent.
antiPatterns: Do not add broad using directives without confirming the namespace.
Do not assume absence from a diff means the type does not exist.

successCriteria: The CS0246 family reaches zero for the type.
No new ambiguous-reference errors were introduced.
